summary: Iteration 14 — Verified Department + HRBP filter dropdowns and Excel export buttons across yapikredi tenant. All 22 backend pytest tests pass. Frontend: dept-selector + hrbp-selector render on TopBar with correct 10 depts and 5 HRBPs, selection triggers refetch with correct query params, Excel export buttons visible on all 8 target pages. Public /raporlar/yapikredi report page also renders dept + hrbp dropdowns after password. Important: yapikredi and parakende tenants needed re-seeding — pre-existing employee records had no `hrbp` field, causing HRBP filter to return 0 rows. After POST /api/tenants/{id}/seed the filter works end-to-end.

minor.issue: hrbp filter silently returns 0 rows if tenant seeded before the hrbp field was added to generate_seed_data. Any tenant not re-seeded after the HRBP feature will look broken. Consider a data-migration script that back-fills hrbp on existing employees from HRBP_MAP[department], instead of requiring a full destructive re-seed.
Filter validation is missing: passing hrbp='NonExistent' or department='Foo' returns 200 with headcount=0 instead of 400. For hygiene, validate against the tenant's HRBP/DEPT list.

issues: With PDF + country + dept + hrbp + year selectors all shown, the TopBar becomes crowded on <1440px screens. flex-wrap is set so it wraps to a second line, but the visual density is high — consider grouping filters behind a Funnel popover on narrow screens.

test_results.backend_pytest: 22/22 pass — /app/backend/tests/test_filters_and_export.py (segments endpoint, dept filter, hrbp filter, and dept+hrbp combo on 17 endpoints)

frontend_playwright.ucret-benchmark Excel buttons: 2 visible (review request said 4; only 2 render — likely ExcelExportButton returns null for empty data arrays on 2 of the 4 sections)

action_items: Add a lightweight data migration (script or startup routine) that back-fills `hrbp` on employees using HRBP_MAP[department] so existing tenants don't need destructive re-seed to activate the HRBP filter.

Verify whether Ücret Benchmark is expected to expose 4 Excel buttons; only 2 render at runtime because ExcelExportButton returns null on empty data. If the other 2 sections are supposed to always have data, populate their arrays or move the export button into the same JSX branch as the table.
Consider validating `department` and `hrbp` query params against the tenant taxonomy and returning 400 on unknown values instead of silently returning empty results.
critical_code_review_comments: tenantInterceptor.js only appends department/hrbp for POST/PUT to segment (not department/hrbp), so form submits that go to any /api endpoint won't be tenant-scoped by dept/hrbp. Harmless today because no dashboard endpoint is POST, but a footgun.

ExcelExportButton returns null for empty arrays — silently hides. This makes it hard for QA/PM to confirm that a page is 'export-enabled'; consider rendering a disabled button with a tooltip 'Veri bulunamadı' instead so its absence isn't confused with a missing feature.

DashboardRoutes uses `key={`seg-${segment}-dept-${department}-hrbp-${hrbp}`}` on a wrapper <div>. Any filter change fully remounts every route child, discarding local UI state (open accordions, scroll positions, sub-tab selection). Prefer passing filters as props and letting children refetch on prop change.

generate_seed_data writes `hrbp` denormalised per-employee. Same fragility as `segment`: any future importer path (excel_handler.py) or bulk update MUST populate this field. Recommend deriving hrbp server-side at query time from HRBP_MAP[department] so the filter is not schema-dependent.
PATCH is not supported on /api/tenants/{id} (returns 405); only PUT is registered. Fine but inconsistent with REST norms; document or add PATCH.

rca_of_the_issue: HRBP filter appeared broken (0 headcount for every HRBP) because the yapikredi tenant was originally seeded before the `hrbp` field was added to generate_seed_data(). MongoDB employees documents had no `hrbp` key, so the query `{'hrbp': 'Ayşe Demir'}` matched nothing. Reproduction: 1) generate_seed_data assigns hrbp only at write time; 2) existing DB documents lack the key; 3) get_filtered() adds `query['hrbp']=hrbp`, filtering to zero. Mitigation applied: POST /api/tenants/{id}/seed re-seeded both tenants. Long-term mitigation: implement a one-shot back-fill (`db.employees.update_many({'hrbp': {'$exists': False}}, {'$set': {'hrbp': HRBP_MAP[dept]}})` for each dept) or derive hrbp at query time by translating `hrbp` param to `{'department': {'$in': dept_list_for_that_hrbp}}`.
